primitives.note: H-28G Evolution Turret / H-28Q Apex Turret is a deployed pet that independently attacks a nearby target with its own rapid-fire hit and a separately-charging beam hit; its damage stacks scale off Heimerdinger's current AP/level continuously.
Turret Kit charges (max 3, 1 kit per cast, ~20s recharge modified by ability haste) gate how many turrets Heimerdinger can deploy/redeploy inside the 15s window.

W fires 5 separately-resolved rocket hits per cast (initial + 4 lesser-damage subsequent hits on the same target), or 4 waves of 5 (20 hits, tiered lesser-damage) once upgraded by R; E's R-upgraded Lightning Grenade bounces 3 times but only damages a champion once per cast.

R (UPGRADE!!!, 3 ranks) permanently transforms one basic ability per rank into an evolved form (Apex Turret / Rocket Swarm / Lightning Grenade) with different damage numbers and mechanics; which abilities are evolved depends on player choice and R rank.
Mana costs (Q 20 + a kit, W 50-90, E 85, R 100 on toggle) constrain how many casts fit in the 15s fight; empowered (R-upgraded) casts are free of mana cost.

needsBespoke.why: The turret (Q) is a persistent pet with two independent, differently-scaling attack types (basic rapid-fire and a beam that charges up over time and receives partial/full charge grants from W and E landing on champions), up to three turrets can be alive at once, and a turret-kit ammo economy governs redeployment; the R-upgraded Apex Turret additionally expires after a fixed 8s and must be refreshed. None of this (a multi-instance pet with an internal charge-meter fed by sibling abilities) is captured by a single primitive; it needs bespoke turret-state simulation layered on top of pet-or-summon and weapon-or-ammo-system.

proposal: Assume R is already at rank 3 with Q, W, and E all pre-upgraded (Apex Turret, Rocket Swarm, Lightning Grenade active) before the 15s fight begins.
Opening: deploy all 3 available turret kits as Apex Turrets adjacent to the dummy (3x Q) to start their beam-charge and rapid-fire damage immediately.

Immediately follow with W (Rocket Swarm, 4 waves of 5 rockets) and then E (Lightning Grenade) on the dummy to grant the turrets beam charge (20% per rocket hit, full charge from the grenade) and add burst magic damage.
Recast W and E on cooldown for the rest of the fight (W 7-11s depending on rank, E 11s), each cast also topping up turret beam charge.
Recast Q whenever a turret kit charge is available and/or an Apex Turret is about to expire at its 8s duration, to keep 3 turrets active as continuously as possible.
Do not use any mobility, CC, or vision effects; treat the passive movement speed bonus as irrelevant to the stationary dummy fight.
